## Professional identity

Musa DİVARCI is a technology professional with professional software development experience since 2001.

His core software expertise is centered on Microsoft technologies, .NET and C#, backend architecture, web applications and database-driven systems. His broader technical background includes Python, TypeScript, React, information technologies, system engineering, network architecture, Cisco networking and enterprise IT.

Python is used for AI/data tooling, ingestion, evaluation and automation. TypeScript and React represent modern product-development work. His AI-oriented engineering work includes persistent memory, RAG, semantic retrieval and traceable reasoning architectures.

Within Türkiye's Ministry of National Education (MEB), his professional technology identity is centered on Bilişim Teknolojileri Koordinatörlüğü (Information Technologies Coordination) and IT expertise.
